[Intro]
[G]

[B7]  [D7add13]
[G]

[Verse 1]
[G]Hey there bud, how'd it go
[C#m7b5]last night? I saw
[Cmaj7]you at the band stand looking
[B7]pretty slammed [D7add13]
[G]Did you see me feeding all
[C#m7b5]my drinks to Cam? Probably not
[Cmaj7]I guess, you were quite
[D7add13]the mess
[G]And that girl who tagged along
[C#m7b5]there with you I ne-
[Cmaj7]ver caught her name but she seemed
[B7]fucked up too [D7add13]
[G]From where I sat she looked to
[C#m7b5]be having fun Keeping up
[Cmaj7]with you, just like
[D7add13]I used to

[Solo 1]
[G]
[C#m7b5]
[Cmaj7]
[B7]  [D7add13]
[G]
[C#m7b5]
[Cmaj7]
[D7add13]

[Verse 2]
[G]Hey there bud, how'd it go
[C#m7b5]last night? I'm sor-
[Cmaj7]ry to have ditched out but I was
[B7]pretty high [D7add13]
[G]Heard from Leslie that on
[C#m7b5]his stumble home Nat was pu-
[Cmaj7]king up all that beer
[D7add13]she'd drunk
[G]Though we didn't talk much how'd
[C#m7b5]your evening go You bare-
[Cmaj7]ly spoke a word to me besides
[B7]that slurred hello [D7add13]
[G]But I happened to see with-
[C#m7b5]out even tryin' How she laughed
[Cmaj7]with you, just like
[D7add13]I used to

[G]
[C#m7b5]
[Cmaj7]
[B7]  [D7add13]
[G]
[C#m7b5]
[Cmaj7]
[D7add13]

[Verse 3]
[G]Hey there bud, how'd it go
[C#m7b5]last night? I woke
[Cmaj7]up to a pair of shoes I've not
[B7]seen next to mine [D7add13]
[G]Did you whisper as you crept
[C#m7b5]in through the door How you'd ne-
[Cmaj7]ver done much like this
[D7add13]before?
[G]I was thinking back just
[C#m7b5]the other day Remem-
[Cmaj7]ber when we used to sneak out late
[B7]to go and blaze [D7add13]
[G]Seemed like loneliness was all
[C#m7b5]we'd ever do But now she's know-
[Cmaj7]ing you, just like
[D7add13]I used to
